assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
The history of transient ischemic attack is coded Z86.73
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia contributing to symptoms and potential stroke risk
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The cardiac event monitor service is coded CPT 93271
The service addresses the documented clinical concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia in a patient with a history of transient ischemic attack
The service supports the medical necessity of the denied Cardiac Event Monitoring service
